pages.text: The $(item)Fusion Table$() is a magical crafting station that allows you to fuse $(item)Custom Girl Spawn Eggs$() with different items to create specialized variants.$(br2)This table harnesses ancient fusion magic to combine spawn eggs with tame items.

$(bold)Function:$()$(br)Right-click the Fusion Table to open its GUI. Place a $(item)Custom Girl Spawn Egg$() in the base slot, then add two identical tame items to the other slots.$(br2)Different tame items will create different girl variants. The result will appear in the output slot.$(br2)$(o)Note: Only identical tame items work for fusion!$()
Craft the Fusion Table using blaze powder, diamonds, ender pearls, and iron ingots in this specific pattern.
